summary: Make releases reproducible, observable, and recoverable with explicit gates.
intents: prepare the release notes and version bump
set up a CI pipeline with a deploy gate
plan a rollback for tomorrow's deployment
cut a new release from main
prerequisites: release target, environment, and authorization for any deployment

verify.description: No unpinned or non-registry dependencies in the release

verify: Release gates (tests, scans, approvals) are listed with their result
A rollback procedure exists and was rehearsed or reviewed
